What US App Store submission from Asia typically involves

Every team’s situation differs, but indie developers in Asia usually work through these buckets before the US listing goes live. Verify current requirements in Apple Developer Program enrollment and App Store Connect — Apple updates fields and agreements without much warning.

1. Apple Developer Program account

  • Enroll as an individual or organization under Apple’s rules for your country/region
  • Complete identity verification and any local business documents Apple requests
  • Accept Program License Agreement updates when Connect prompts you
  • Create the app record: bundle ID, SKU, primary language — align signing certificates in Xcode first

We do not enroll on your behalf or impersonate you in Apple’s verification flow. The Ship from Asia pack walks through the order we check — it is not done-for-you Developer Program signup.

2. US listing copy (en-US)

  • Add en-US localization in App Store Connect — title, subtitle, description, keywords, promotional text
  • Screenshots sized for required iPhone (and iPad if universal) device classes
  • Privacy policy URL reachable from the US; support URL that loads for US reviewers
  • Review Notes: test account, steps to reach paywalled features, how to exercise IAP

If your zh-Hans listing is finished but en-US still reads like machine translation, US conversion and review friction both suffer. AppLocale ($79 one-time) delivers paste-ready English and Chinese fields — we improve clarity, we do not promise search rank.

3. Tax and banking (high level only)

  • Sign the Paid Apps Agreement in App Store Connect before selling paid apps or IAP
  • Complete tax forms Apple asks for (often US W-8BEN or W-9 equivalents depending on entity type and treaty status)
  • Add payout banking Connect accepts in your region — many Asia indie teams use local accounts; some use multi-currency services where permitted
  • Understand withholding and reporting are between you, Apple, and your tax advisor — we do not file on your behalf

This section is orientation only, not tax or legal advice. Read Apple’s tax and banking help in Connect and consult qualified professionals for your jurisdiction.

4. Build, privacy, and review

  • Upload a production build via Xcode or CI; complete export compliance and content-rights questions honestly
  • Privacy Nutrition Labels that match your SDKs and privacy policy — wrong answers fail review more often than empty ones
  • IAP configured before review if digital features are gated; reviewers test purchase and Restore
  • Guideline 4.3(b) risk: avoid shipping a fleet of look-alike apps copied from another region unchanged

FAQ

Can I submit to the US App Store from Asia without a US company?

Usually yes. Many indie developers enroll in the Apple Developer Program as an individual or local entity in their home country and sell on the US storefront. Apple’s enrollment rules and required documents vary by country — verify in Apple Developer Program enrollment and App Store Connect. This page is not legal or immigration advice.

You can add an en-US localization in App Store Connect while keeping zh-Hans. US buyers expect English title, subtitle, description, and screenshots. For a paste-ready bilingual rewrite, see AppLocale ($79 one-time) — still no ranking promise.
